spellbook.finance/limitations: The list contains positive seller controls only. It omits platform provenance, experiment metadata and adaptive tuning.
A list does not prove a profile is applied to a marketplace; read channel pins separately.
Workspace membership and seller entitlement remain backend-enforced.

description: List seller-created pricing profiles by name and active state, plus the resulting active profile id. Call it before choosing a profile for detail, update, activation or channel pinning.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_profiles_list
